title: ACTIVATIONREASONING: LOGICAL REASONING IN LATENT ACTIVATION SPACES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the balanced accuracy of detecting discrimination, stereotype, and injustice concepts in text using logical reasoning over Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent features on the BeaverTails dataset.
Evaluating the balanced accuracy of identifying hate speech and offensive language using explicit logical rules applied to the model's latent activation space on the BeaverTails dataset.
